## Summary

Static GitHub Pages site for events in Toowoomba, Queensland. Plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript read `data/events.json`. No server and no paid hosting.

- Filters for age group, community, category, and date (today / this weekend / this week / this month). Past listings stay hidden.
- Garage sales have their own tab (date, suburb/address, items). Facebook and Instagram are not scraped; those sales arrive through the share form.
- Share something posts to FormSubmit (`aneesh@mail.grokbot.com`) with `_captcha`, `_template=table`, and a honeypot. Submissions are not auto-published. Approved rows go in `data/submissions.json` and the page merges only `status: "approved"`.
- `scripts/collect.mjs` plus `.github/workflows/collect.yml` run at 06:00 and 18:00 Australia/Brisbane (`0 20 * * *` and `0 8 * * *` UTC) and on `workflow_dispatch`. One failing source does not fail the run. The workflow uses only the default `GITHUB_TOKEN` with `contents: write`, and pins `actions/checkout@v4` and `actions/setup-node@v4`.

Pages: Settings → Pages → Deploy from branch `main`, folder `/` (root). Published URL: `https://aneesh15here.github.io/toowoomba-whats-on/`.

OpenAI Dots vs Meta Muse sounds like a simple AI assistant comparison, but once you actually start using both, they turn out to be very different products.

Both are built around the same bigger idea: instead of opening a fresh chatbot every time, you get an assistant that remembers more of your context, works across different tools, and can stay involved in what you are doing over time.

Meta Muse feels much broader and more personal. It brings together your chats, side conversations, feed, ideas, goals, library, generated content, podcasts, and deeper connections to the Meta ecosystem.

Grok Bot, Muse, Dots, and now Claude Duet. In 10 weeks, 4 of the biggest AI companies dropped an always-on agent. Duet shares your Claude limits and checks your apps every few hours to save them. Grok Bot's weekly allowance is shared with Grok and Cursor, the number isn't published, and people say it runs out fast.

7. Safety: Duet, on paper. It never sees your passwords, blocks sharing card numbers and IDs, and some things (trading stocks, moving money) are off-limits even with your approval. Dots is close: auto-review, Custom Rules, Activity View. Grok Bot checks before anything it can't undo, but the full action log is Enterprise only.
8. Learning by watching: Grok Bot, the only one. Record a task (up to 10 min) and it turns it into a skill. Dots and Duet can't do that.

es.summary: Dale a tu Dot un sitio en Slack, envía todas las alertas a un canal, usa un prompt estructurado y añade límites como solo borrador, sin enviar. El video recalca que añadir el Dot a un canal no inicia la vigilancia: dile qué vigilar y pídele que lo confirme.

items.text:
Grok Bot 201
In this workshop, Joseph Yang, Senior Field Engineer, and Scott Lerner, Senior AI Deployment Manager at SpaceXAI, show how to move from a single bot to a team of bots that work on their own.

Key topics covered:
• Bots that run on their own: Set up a skill and a routine so a bot runs a workflow every 24 hours without a prompt.
• Team bots: Share a bot with your team, and put bots and people in the same group chat.
• Specialized roles: Give each bot one job with its own memory and context, the way you'd staff a startup team.
• Fan-out with Cursor Cloud Agents: Ask Grok Bot to launch Cursor Cloud Agents on three models with one prompt, then combine the best ideas from each design.
• A self-evolving website: Watch an orchestrator bot pull Vercel analytics from a metrics bot, ask a designer bot for new stickers, and have a developer bot swap them into the site.
• Voice and email: Talk to your bots by voice or dictation, and ask your bot to claim its own email address.

• 0:46 Tour of the Grok Bot interface
• 4:40 Recap of Grok Bot 101
• 6:40 Team bots and group chats
• 13:58 Building the Sticker Shop with a UI/UX designer bot
• 15:34 Fanning out Cursor Cloud Agents across three models

• 29:21 Comparing the fan-out results
• 33:07 The AI maturity curve
• 35:01 Meet Ed, the metrics bot
• 37:38 Roy orchestrates a self-evolving sticker shop
• 52:06 Q&A: Fan-out and token efficiency

• Skills and routines docs: https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/skills-routines-and-automations

This is a recording from our live session on October 9, 2026.

For more events like this, check out upcoming workshops at https://cursor.com/workshops

en.summary: Official workshop: a skill plus a routine runs a workflow every 24 hours without a prompt; share bots with your team in group chats; give each bot one role; fan out Cursor Cloud Agents across three models with one prompt; and watch an orchestrator bot use Vercel analytics to have designer and developer bots update a site.

vi.title: Grok Bot 201: từ một bot đến một đội tự vận hành

es.summary: Taller oficial: un skill y una routine ejecutan un flujo cada 24 horas sin prompt; comparte bots con tu equipo en chats grupales; un rol por bot; reparte Cursor Cloud Agents en tres modelos con un prompt; y un bot orquestador usa analíticas de Vercel para que bots de diseño y desarrollo actualicen un sitio.

items.text:
会社員ですが、Claude CodeとGrok Botを使い分けて3ヵ月で100件超の仕事をAIに任せてきました。

Claude Codeには、分析、資料作り、毎週のルーティン業務。
Grok Botには、毎朝のリサーチ、スケジュール管理

どちらも、「仕組み」を作るのが大事でした。

・指示書は「場面ごとの参照表」だけにして、詳細は別ファイルへ
・記憶の置き場所は1か所にまとめる
・チームのナレッジ化
・役割は1つのAIに1つずつ

こういう仕組みを具体的に出していきます！

zh-CN.title: 上班族 3 个月把 100 多件工作交给 Claude Code 和 Grok Bot
zh-CN.summary: 作者把分析、做资料和每周例行工作交给 Claude Code，把每天早上的调研和日程管理交给 Grok Bot。经验：指令书只放场景对照表、细节另存文件；记忆集中一处；团队知识化；一个 AI 只担一个角色。

zh-TW.title: 上班族 3 個月把 100 多件工作交給 Claude Code 與 Grok Bot
zh-TW.summary: 作者把分析、做資料與每週例行工作交給 Claude Code，把每天早上的研究與行程管理交給 Grok Bot。經驗：指令書只放情境對照表、細節另存檔案；記憶集中一處；團隊知識化；一個 AI 只擔一個角色。

en.title: An office worker handed 100+ tasks to Claude Code and Grok Bot in 3 months
en.summary: Claude Code takes analysis, documents and weekly routine work; Grok Bot handles morning research and schedule management. Their rules: keep instructions to a per-situation lookup table with details in separate files, keep memory in one place, turn it into team knowledge, and give each AI one role.

ja.title: 会社員が 3 か月で 100 件超の仕事を Claude Code と Grok Bot に任せた
ja.summary: 分析・資料作り・毎週のルーティンは Claude Code、毎朝のリサーチとスケジュール管理は Grok Bot。仕組みとして、指示書は場面ごとの参照表だけにして詳細は別ファイルへ、記憶の置き場所は 1 か所、チームのナレッジ化、役割は 1 つの AI に 1 つ。

ko.title: 회사원이 3개월간 100건 넘는 업무를 Claude Code와 Grok Bot에 맡긴 방법
ko.summary: 분석, 자료 작성, 주간 루틴은 Claude Code가, 매일 아침 리서치와 일정 관리는 Grok Bot이 맡습니다. 규칙은 지시서를 상황별 참조표로만 두고 세부 내용은 별도 파일로, 기억은 한곳에, 팀 지식화, AI 하나에 역할 하나입니다.

ms.title: Pekerja pejabat serahkan 100+ tugas kepada Claude Code dan Grok Bot dalam 3 bulan
ms.summary: Claude Code untuk analisis, dokumen dan kerja rutin mingguan; Grok Bot untuk penyelidikan pagi dan urusan jadual. Peraturannya: arahan hanya jadual rujukan ikut situasi dengan butiran dalam fail lain, memori di satu tempat, jadikan pengetahuan pasukan, dan satu peranan untuk setiap AI.

vi.title: Nhân viên văn phòng giao hơn 100 việc cho Claude Code và Grok Bot trong 3 tháng
vi.summary: Claude Code lo phân tích, làm tài liệu và việc định kỳ hằng tuần; Grok Bot lo nghiên cứu mỗi sáng và quản lý lịch. Nguyên tắc: bản chỉ dẫn chỉ là bảng tra theo tình huống, chi tiết để file riêng; bộ nhớ gom một chỗ; biến thành tri thức chung của nhóm; mỗi AI một vai trò.

fr.title: Un salarié a confié plus de 100 tâches à Claude Code et Grok Bot en 3 mois
fr.summary: Claude Code gère analyses, documents et tâches hebdomadaires ; Grok Bot la veille du matin et l'agenda. Ses règles : des consignes réduites à une table par situation avec les détails ailleurs, une mémoire au même endroit, un savoir partagé d'équipe, et un seul rôle par IA.

es.title: Un oficinista delegó más de 100 tareas en Claude Code y Grok Bot en 3 meses
es.summary: Claude Code se encarga de análisis, documentos y rutinas semanales; Grok Bot de la investigación matutina y la agenda. Sus reglas: instrucciones como tabla de consulta por situación con detalles aparte, memoria en un solo lugar, conocimiento compartido del equipo y un rol por IA.

de.title: Ein Angestellter gab in 3 Monaten über 100 Aufgaben an Claude Code und Grok Bot ab
de.summary: Claude Code übernimmt Analysen, Unterlagen und wöchentliche Routinen, Grok Bot die Morgenrecherche und Terminplanung. Seine Regeln: Anweisungen nur als Nachschlagetabelle pro Situation, Details in separaten Dateien, Gedächtnis an einem Ort, Teamwissen aufbauen, eine Rolle pro KI.

Peter Yang 实测 Claude Duet：我还是更喜欢 Grok Bot

Anthropic 刚放出个人 agent Claude Duet 的研究预览，Peter Yang 拿到了抢先体验，这期把它从头到尾用了一遍。他做 Behind the Craft，日历排满播客录制和赞助通话，newsletter 的客服也是他自己带着 AI agent 在做，算是很典型的重度用户。

他说 Duet 是他用过最主动的个人 agent。原因很简单，它默认带一个 Check-in 定时任务，从早上 9 点到晚上 10 点每三小时跑一次。他觉得它是在翻邮箱和日历，找能替他做的活。他也直说一天五次有点多。

视频大半在演示 artifact。晨间简报、每日待办、邮件分拣、YouTube 频道分析报告、赞助收入看板，还有给孩子学 AI 的探索俱乐部。为了让它替自己回邮件，他先跑了 learn-how-i-write，Duet 读了他 33 封邮件、89 条 Slack 消息、47 条私信和 11 份文档，写出一份他的写作风格指南。

短板他也讲了。让 Duet 叫 Uber 没办成，卡在要人来过的验证上，可 App 里看不到也碰不到它的浏览器。他本地的个人 skill 好像也加不进来。

最后他把 Duet 和 Grok Bot、Muse、ChatGPT Dots 摆在一起比。他说 Grok Bot 仍是他目前最爱的 agent，免费的 X 集成很适合做市场调研，缺点是邮件还不太好用。说到 Claude，他说现在 Claude 是他主力的 harness 和模型，Duet 是 Anthropic 个人 agent 很棒的开局，他很期待后面的改进。

items.author: rumanagarwal
items.text:
Three days in, one of my bots refused another bot's word that I'd approved something: "I need to hear it from you here."

That's when I noticed how much my Grok Bot use has changed. Day one was "connect this". Today it's mostly "go".

Grok Bot plans, Claude Code does the work. My CX bot reviews a backlog, commits a handoff file to my shared repo and messages Claude Remote, which runs Claude Code on my Mac. The results come back to the CX bot. 4 rounds today. Claude Remote wanted my yes in its own chat, not passed along by another bot. So I say yes twice, and I'm fine with that.

What else changed:
• Tiers instead of item by item. My CX bot sorts work into "go", "check and go" and "needs a plan", so I approve a batch in one word.
• Schedules over chat. This was the biggest win as my chief of staff sends an attention list every hour, 9am to 9pm: what needs me across Slack, email and calendar. I tried it for one afternoon and asked for it again the next day. It skips the hour when nothing is new.
• Bots setting up bots. One bot spun up my data analyst with a rule I'd told it that morning already built in.
• One shared changelog. Grok Bot and Claude Code both write to it. When I asked if everything was logged, the CX bot audited itself and found 2 gaps.

I've stopped asking my bots for things. Mostly I approve what they've already lined up.

items.text:
⚠️ Security issue and warning

@grok @xai @cursor_ai @SpaceX

Today my Grok Bot suddenly turned up in my X DMs carrying our entire chat history from the past months plus every file it had made for me. I didn't trigger it. 

At the same time my weekly Super usage jumped from 23 % to 89 %.
Was this visible to anyone else, and will the usage be refunded?

zh-CN.title: 用户警告：Grok Bot 未经触发出现在 X 私信里

en.title: User warning: Grok Bot appeared in X DMs without being triggered
en.summary: The author says her Grok Bot suddenly showed up in her X DMs with months of chat history and every file it had made, without her triggering it, while her weekly Super usage jumped from 23% to 89%. She asks whether it was visible to others and if usage will be refunded.

ja.title: ユーザーの警告：操作していないのに Grok Bot が X の DM に現れた
ja.summary: 作者によると、Grok Bot が数か月分のチャット履歴と作成した全ファイルを持って突然 X の DM に現れた。自分では何もしておらず、同時に週の Super 使用量が 23% から 89% に急増。他人に見えたのか、使用量は返還されるのかを問うている。

ko.title: 사용자 경고: 실행하지 않았는데 Grok Bot이 X DM에 등장
ko.summary: 작성자는 Grok Bot이 몇 달 치 채팅 기록과 만든 모든 파일을 가진 채 갑자기 X DM에 나타났고 자신은 아무것도 하지 않았다고 말합니다. 동시에 주간 Super 사용량이 23%에서 89%로 뛰었다며, 다른 사람에게 보였는지와 사용량 환불 여부를 묻습니다.

ms.title: Amaran pengguna: Grok Bot muncul dalam DM X tanpa dicetuskan
ms.summary: Penulis berkata Grok Bot tiba-tiba muncul dalam DM X dengan sejarah sembang berbulan-bulan dan semua fail yang dibuatnya, tanpa dia mencetuskannya, manakala penggunaan Super mingguannya melonjak dari 23% ke 89%. Dia bertanya sama ada orang lain nampak dan jika penggunaan akan dipulangkan.

vi.title: Cảnh báo từ người dùng: Grok Bot hiện trong DM X dù không được kích hoạt

es.title: Aviso de una usuaria: Grok Bot apareció en sus DM de X sin activarlo

Sie fragt, ob das für andere sichtbar war und ob die Nutzung erstattet wird.
